items.title: David Weinstein Interview, 1988-09-22
items.q: So that's how I got to meet little Pecoraro... because he was Santo's younger. And he played a few jobs with us, with the dance band part of the Donbusters.

ctx.x: What was Mouse Pecoraro's real name? You know the drummer?
Do you know his middle name by any chance? No, I don't.
